[NCBK.1.8] **Unregistered (NULL) callbacks silently drop, except where the verb
is essential.** Default state at engine creation: nothing registered. A verb
whose contract requires delivery returns an explicit error when its callback is
unset — `call` returns `DS_ERR_STORAGE_UNAVAILABLE` ([IDSP.6.4]), including a
call that stores a fact. The cache verbs are **not** essential: `cached()` reads the
engine's own map, and `cache` / `cache_delete` fall back to a volatile in-engine
cache when no persistence callback is wired ([NCBK.7.3]).
